_comment: HK City Monitor — data source registry. One entry per candidate source. `probe_sources.py` tests every URL here and writes SOURCES.md + data/sources_report.json. status/verified_at are filled in BY THE PROBE, never by hand. To add a source: append an object, run python3 scripts/probe_sources.py.

_schema.id: stable id, used as the layer/panel key in code
_schema.group: cameras | weather | transport | border | aviation | marine | civic | news | market | geospatial | global
_schema.name: human label (Traditional Chinese preferred)
_schema.type: json | csv | xml | rss | image | html
_schema.url: the URL the app should actually fetch
_schema.candidates: optional list of alternative URLs to try if url fails (used to resolve unknowns)
_schema.hk_filter: true if it is a global source that needs a Hong Kong bbox/param filter
_schema.notes: gotchas, licence, CORS, why it matters
_schema.todo: true if this is still an unresolved candidate

sources.name: 運輸署 交通快拍攝影機位置
sources.notes: UTF-16LE with a DOUBLE BOM (\xff\xfe\xff\xfe) and tab-delimited. Columns: key, region, district, description, easting, northing, latitude, longitude, url. Python's utf-16 codec leaves a stray \ufeff on the first field name — strip it or every row reads empty.

sources.name: 運輸署 交通快拍圖像（單張）
sources.notes: 1013 cameras. 320x240 JPEG ~30KB. May answer 301/302 — follow redirects. Key list from td_camera_list. Timestamp is burned into the image by TD.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣攝影機（單站 HD）
sources.notes: 34 stations verified 200. URL pattern: wxinfo/aws/hko_mica/{lower}/{latest_HD_|latest_}{UPPER}.jpg. Station codes come from www.hko.gov.hk/en/wxinfo/ts/index_webcam.htm. HD is ~462KB, the non-HD variant ~88KB.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣攝影機目錄頁
sources.notes: Source of the 34 station codes. Not machine-readable — parse once, hardcode the list.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣警告一覽
sources.notes: CORS allow-origin * so the browser can fetch directly. Returns {} when no warning is in force. Otherwise keyed by warning code with name, code, actionCode, issueTime, updateTime, expireTime.

sources.name: 天文台 詳細天氣警告資訊
sources.notes: Full warning text, useful for a detail drawer.

sources.name: 天文台 本港現況（溫度、濕度、雨量、紫外線）
sources.notes: temperature.data[] per place, humidity, rainfall.data[] per 18 districts, uvindex, icon. recordTime/updateTime fields carry the observation time.

sources.name: 天文台 九天天氣預報
天文台 特別天氣提示
sources.notes: Returns a nearly-empty body when nothing is active.

sources.name: 天文台 潮汐資料
sources.notes: dataType=hhOT is REJECTED ('Please include valid parameters') — wrong name. Find the correct tide dataType in the HKO Open Data API documentation PDF.

sources.name: 天文台 環境伽馬輻射水平
sources.notes: Guessed dataType rejected. Find the correct one in the HKO Open Data API documentation PDF.

sources.name: 天文台 地震速報
sources.notes: Guessed dataTypes rejected. Find the correct ones for the worldwide M6+ quick report and locally-felt tremor reports.

sources.name: 天文台 天氣雷達圖（256km）
sources.notes: Real URL not yet pinned — all guessed patterns 404. The radar page loads the image from JS, so extract it from the page source.

sources.name: 天文台 衛星雲圖
sources.notes: Real URL not yet pinned.

sources.name: 環保署 空氣質素健康指數（AQHI）
sources.notes: Guessed paths all 404. Find the real XHR the aqhi.gov.hk front end calls, or the data.gov.hk resource for the AQHI dataset. Also want the AQHI station list with coordinates.

sources.name: 運輸署 行車速度圖
sources.notes: REAL PATHS NOT FOUND: resource.data.one.gov.hk/td/speedmap.xml returns 404 (the 404 body is a decoy PHP index that lists paths which do not exist). Use td_traffic_speed_city (JSON) instead; for XML find the current TIS path on data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 運輸署 行車時間顯示器
sources.notes: REAL PATH NOT FOUND: resource.data.one.gov.hk/td/journeytime.xml returns 404. See the City Dashboard journey-time dataset on data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 運輸署 特別交通消息
sources.notes: Also available in en and sc. Good event-feed source for the map.

sources.name: 行車速度圖（City Dashboard 版，JSON）
sources.notes: JSON twin of the TIS XML — much easier for a static front end.

sources.name: 運輸署 實時停車場空位
sources.notes: Real-time vacancy counts. The JSON body starts with a UTF-8 BOM — decode as utf-8-sig or json.loads throws. Key: car_park[].

sources.name: 實時空置車位（一站式整合版）
sources.notes: Merges TD and Kai Tak (start-up Kowloon East) car park feeds.

sources.name: 城巴／新大嶼山巴士 ETA
sources.notes: Batch endpoint — a GET returns 422, it needs a POST body of stop ids. Also has per-route ETA endpoints under rt.data.gov.hk.

sources.name: 保安局「口岸通」陸路管制站情況
sources.notes: Green/yellow/red status plus average waiting time per land control point, and incident notices. The page itself has no data — find the JSON endpoint its JS calls. Highest-value unresolved source.

sources.name: 香港出行易 管制站狀況
sources.notes: Page is a ~3.5KB JS app. Find its data endpoint. Covers passenger and private-car channels.

sources.name: 入境處 13 個出入境管制站＋開放時間
sources.notes: Static list of 13 control points with opening hours. Hardcode once — lets the UI show 現正開放／已關閉 without any live source.

sources.name: adsb.lol 香港範圍航班（社群 ADS-B）
sources.notes: NO KEY, NO REGISTRATION. Verified: 40 aircraft within 100nm of Hong Kong. This is the practical flights layer — OpenSky's anonymous tier is rate-limited. Radius in nautical miles.

sources.name: OpenSky Network 香港 bbox
sources.notes: Verified: 23 aircraft in the HK bbox anonymously. Free account raises the rate limit. Use as fallback to adsb.lol.

sources.name: AISStream 船隻 AIS（WebSocket）
sources.notes: Free API key. WebSocket with a bounding-box subscription — CANNOT run from a static page. Needs a persistent VPS collector that writes static JSON. Dark ships (AIS off) need paid satellite AIS: out of scope.

sources.name: 康文署 康體活動節目（未來約 1.5 個月）
sources.notes: This is the 'what's on soon' feed. Note the http (not https) scheme. Try the https variant too and prefer it if it works.

sources.name: 康文署 康體設施使用率（年度）
sources.notes: Annual statistics only — NOT live booking availability. Do not present as real-time.

sources.name: 康文署 設施地理數據（約 30 類，CSDI）
sources.notes: One CSDI dataset per facility type (swimming pools, sports centres, tennis courts, badminton courts, basketball courts, libraries, museums, parks and zoos, holiday camps, barbecue areas, ...). Need the reusable WFS / ArcGIS REST FeatureServer access path. Example dataset id: lcsd_rcd_1634540558875_77434 (swimming pools).

sources.name: 漁護署 郊野公園封閉山徑
sources.notes: CSDI dataset afcd_rcd_1742550096880_1424. Also see the closed-facilities dataset (cpclosedfacilitiescsdi).

sources.name: 香港公眾假期
sources.notes: Find a machine-readable JSON/CSV/ICS source (data.gov.hk or gov.hk).

sources.name: 政府新聞公報 RSS（全部）
sources.notes: VERIFIED: 100 items. Publish TITLE + LINK ONLY — never republish article bodies. Still want the 治安 (law and order) topic feed; the full feed list is on gov.hk/tc/about/rss.htm.

sources.name: 消防處 新聞公報
sources.notes: Find an RSS/JSON form of this list if one exists.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance 恒生指數
sources.notes: NO CORS header — must be proxied server side (nginx proxy_pass, 3 lines). Verified working: ^HSI 24750.78 HKD, ^HSCE, 0700.HK, 9988.HK, 3690.HK, 1810.HK, 0005.HK, 0388.HK, 1299.HK, 0939.HK also work. DELAYED — must be labelled 延遲報價 in the UI.

sources.name: CoinGecko 加密貨幣
sources.notes: Free tier is rate-limited but keyless.

sources.name: CARTO dark-matter 底圖 style
sources.notes: Keyless vector basemap style for MapLibre. 93 layers, CJK-capable font stacks (HanWangHeiLight / NanumBarunGothic), glyph server at tiles.basemaps.cartocdn.com/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf. MUST be referenced as a style URL — passing it as an inline style object to MapLibre 4.7.x silently fails.

sources.name: CSDI 空間數據共享平台 API
sources.notes: Need the real WFS / ArcGIS REST base and one demonstrated GetFeature returning GeoJSON.

sources.name: 地政總署 地址搜尋（ALS / Location Search API）
sources.notes: Hostname moved from geodata.gov.hk to www.map.gov.hk effective 2026-05-04. Need the working address-to-coordinates query. Used for geocoding news/event text — do NOT let an LLM invent coordinates.

sources.name: USGS 地震（香港 bbox）
sources.notes: Keyless. Empty result near HK is expected and correct — widen the bbox for a regional view.

sources.name: NASA EONET 自然事件
sources.notes: Storms, wildfires, floods. Keyless. Large responses — filter client side by bounding box if the bbox param is unsupported.

sources.name: Open-Meteo 格網天氣（香港）
sources.notes: Keyless, CORS-friendly. Useful as a gridded cross-check against HKO station readings.

sources.name: 消委會 油價資訊通（車用燃油價格）
sources.notes: Every oil company's retail price AND after-discount price per station, plus weekly offers. NO official API — it is a server-rendered Typo3 site (plain GET, stable paths such as /tc/price, /tc/station, /tc/today-discount), so it is scrapeable without a browser, but it is still scraping. A third party (talklivelihood.hk) already republishes it. BEST MOVE: ask the Consumer Council for a feed — a public body publishing a consumer tool should be able to publish data. No price data on data.gov.hk (only complaints statistics).

sources.name: 消委會 網上價格一覽通（超市格價）
sources.notes: Supermarket prices across the major chains (惠康, 百佳, Market Place, AEON, 大昌, city'super...) for hundreds of product categories. Hierarchical server-rendered URLs (/opw/list/{cat}/{sub}/{subsub}) but the product pages carry NO prices in the HTML — prices arrive via an AJAX call that still needs reversing. Higher effort and higher fragility than the fuel tool. Prefer asking for a feed.

sources.name: 消委會 嬰幼兒奶粉價格調查
sources.notes: Part of the Consumer Council price-comparison toolkit. Check whether the survey is published as a table or a PDF.

sources.name: 消委會 投訴統計
sources.notes: The ONLY Consumer Council dataset on data.gov.hk. Resolve the real CSV resource URL via the CKAN API.

sources.name: 運輸署 公共交通路線及收費（巴士/小巴/渡輪/電車）
sources.notes: GOTCHA: the CSVs are DAILY CHANGE LOGS only (ROUTE_ID, ROUTE_SEQ, CHANGE = ADD/DELETE/UPDATE) — they contain NO fares. The real fare tables are MS Access files, e.g. FARE_BUS.mdb at 32.9 MB. Full family available: ROUTE_/RSTOP_/STOP_/FARE_ x BUS, GMB (minibus), FERRY, TRAM, PTRAM. To use it: convert the .mdb to SQLite/Parquet once with mdbtools, then apply the daily deltas. A one-off converter is a genuinely useful open-source contribution and the only free source of complete HK public-transport fares.
